title: Arc footer
description: A white five-column footer: a bold lowercase wordmark, three columns of bold group headings over warm-grey links (a column can stack two groups), and a newsletter column with a hairline email field and a full-width filled button; then a hairline and a 12px legal row with copyright, links and social icons on the right. On phones the link columns pair up two by two. Links darken on hover.
notes: the newsletter form has no handler: wire its action up yourself
name: arc-footer

props.name: brand
props.description: the wordmark, set bold in the display face

props.name: columns
props.description: link columns; each inner list is one column, and a column can stack several groups

props.name: newsletter
props.type: { title: string; placeholder: string; button: string; inputLabel: string; }

props.name: legal
props.description: the small legal links in the bottom row

props.name: socials
props.type: { label: string; href: string; icon: ReactNode; }[]
props.description: the social icons at the bottom right (an icon and a screen-reader label each)
